ITEM 1 | Large pale beige-tan piece with a slightly textured, fibrous/flaky surface and some darker browned edges and specks, cut into a rounded, slightly irregular wedge about 9 cm long and 5 cm wide, roughly 2 cm thick at its thickest, with a soft, moist-looking interior and no visible sheen; sits on the left of the plate, partly overlapping a second thinner layer beneath it | 130
ITEM 2 | Irregular piece with a bright green leafy/speckled section and an orange-tan, crumbly, slightly browned baked surface, edges ragged and flaky, about 6 cm across and 1.5 cm thick, with a matte, dry-looking surface; sits to the right of item 1 and touches it at the green edge | 60
ITEM 3 | Thin, smeared orange-brown residue with a slightly glossy, oily look trailing across the plate center below the food, about 8 cm long and under 1 mm thick, flowing lightly and spread thin | 5
